# Overview

The FLAG counterpart to `03_`: 1xFLAG-, 2xFLAG- and 3xFLAG-P2A-NanoLuc placed in
the MDA-MB-231 CDS landscape. **MDA-MB-231 only**, same background and gene set as
`01_` and `03_`, so all three notebooks' panels are directly comparable.

As in `03_`, the whole fusion is one ORF and is measured as one CDS: P2A is
ribosome skipping, not termination. NanoLuc keeps its junction + PEST tail.

**The three constructs differ by only 21 nt per tag copy**, so they are 720, 741
and 762 nt. On a density axis that spans the whole transcriptome those three lines
sit essentially on top of one another; section 6 reports the separation
numerically, which is the only place it is readable. The GC3 panel separates them
slightly better than length does, but not by much. These panels answer "where does
a FLAG-NanoLuc reporter sit", not "how do 1x, 2x and 3x differ from each other".

# Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))
```

```{r params}
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
cat("lfc_cutoff =", lfc_cutoff, "| padj_cutoff =", padj_cutoff, "\n")
```

# 1. Import and Verify the FLAG Tag

```{r read_parts}
parts_xlsx <- here("accessories", "cds seq.xlsx")
stopifnot("accessories/cds seq.xlsx not found" = file.exists(parts_xlsx))

parts_tbl <- read_excel(parts_xlsx)
names(parts_tbl)[1] <- "construct"

parts <- parts_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct), !is.na(cds)) %>%
  transmute(part = tolower(str_trim(construct)),
            seq  = toupper(gsub("\\s", "", cds)))
pseq <- setNames(parts$seq, parts$part)

needed <- c("flag3x", "p2a", "nanoluc", "gfp3xflagdestab")
stopifnot(
  "A required part is missing from cds seq.xlsx" = all(needed %in% names(pseq)),
  "A part contains non-ACGT characters" = all(!grepl("[^ACGT]", pseq[needed])),
  "A part is not divisible by 3" = all(nchar(pseq[needed]) %% 3 == 0)
)

flag3x   <- pseq[["flag3x"]]
FLAG3X_AA <- "DYKDHDGDYKDHDIDYKDDDDK"

cat("flag3x:", nchar(flag3x), "nt,", nchar(flag3x) %/% 3, "codons\n")
cat("  translates to:", as.character(translate(DNAString(flag3x))), "\n")

stopifnot(
  "flag3x is not 66 nt" = nchar(flag3x) == 66,
  "flag3x does not encode the canonical 3xFLAG peptide" =
    as.character(translate(DNAString(flag3x))) == FLAG3X_AA
)
```

An earlier version of this row was pasted as the **reverse complement**, which is
in frame and 66 nt and so passes a length check while translating to nonsense.
That is exactly the failure a range check cannot catch, so the orientation is
asserted two ways: the peptide must be 3xFLAG, and it must agree with the 3xFLAG
already embedded in the `gfp3xflagdestab` row.

```{r verify_orientation}
# Independent confirmation from a second sequence in the same sheet. Compared at
# the PEPTIDE level, not the DNA level: the two copies differ by one synonymous
# base (GGC here vs GGT in gfp3xflagdestab) at the Gly of the first repeat.
gfp3x_aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(pseq[["gfp3xflagdestab"]])))
stopifnot("3xFLAG peptide not found in gfp3xflagdestab" =
            str_detect(gfp3x_aa, fixed(FLAG3X_AA)))
cat("3xFLAG peptide confirmed inside gfp3xflagdestab\n")

# And the reverse complement must NOT encode 3xFLAG, or the check above would
# pass in either orientation and tell us nothing.
flag_rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(flag3x)))
stopifnot("Both orientations encode 3xFLAG: the orientation check is not discriminative" =
            as.character(translate(DNAString(flag_rc))) != FLAG3X_AA)
cat("Reverse complement does NOT encode 3xFLAG, so the check discriminates\n")

# Locate the 3xFLAG peptide in the GFP construct's protein, map back to the
# nucleotides that encode it, and compare base by base with flag3x.
aa_start <- str_locate(gfp3x_aa, fixed(FLAG3X_AA))[1, "start"]
nt_start <- (aa_start - 1) * 3 + 1
gfp3x_dna <- substr(pseq[["gfp3xflagdestab"]], nt_start, nt_start + 65)

stopifnot("Mapped nucleotides do not re-encode 3xFLAG" =
            as.character(translate(DNAString(gfp3x_dna))) == FLAG3X_AA)

n_syn <- sum(strsplit(flag3x, "")[[1]] != strsplit(gfp3x_dna, "")[[1]])
cat("Synonymous base differences vs the gfp3xflagdestab copy:", n_syn,
    "(same peptide, so the tags agree)\n")
```

# 2. Build the Nested 1x / 2x / 3x Tags

The 3xFLAG is three **different** repeats, not three copies of one epitope, so 1x
and 2x are cut from the C-terminal end of the supplied sequence. The three tags
are then nested: 1x is a suffix of 2x is a suffix of 3x, and all three use the
codons from the spreadsheet rather than any written here.

An `ATG` is prepended to each, because FLAG is N-terminal in these fusions and the
supplied tag starts `GAC` (Asp) with no initiator.

```{r build_tags}
# Repeat boundaries: DYKDHDG (7 aa) | DYKDHDI (7 aa) | DYKDDDDK (8 aa).
rep1 <- substr(flag3x,  1, 21)
rep2 <- substr(flag3x, 22, 42)
rep3 <- substr(flag3x, 43, 66)

stopifnot(
  "Repeat split does not reconstitute flag3x" =
    paste0(rep1, rep2, rep3) == flag3x,
  "Repeat 1 is not DYKDHDG"  =
    as.character(translate(DNAString(rep1))) == "DYKDHDG",
  "Repeat 2 is not DYKDHDI"  =
    as.character(translate(DNAString(rep2))) == "DYKDHDI",
  "Repeat 3 is not DYKDDDDK" =
    as.character(translate(DNAString(rep3))) == "DYKDDDDK"
)
cat("3xFLAG splits cleanly into DYKDHDG / DYKDHDI / DYKDDDDK\n")

tags <- list(
  "1xFLAG" = paste0("ATG", rep3),
  "2xFLAG" = paste0("ATG", rep2, rep3),
  "3xFLAG" = paste0("ATG", rep1, rep2, rep3)
)

# Nesting, asserted on the DNA. If a tag were rebuilt from a retyped epitope
# rather than cut from the supplied sequence, this is what would fail.
stopifnot(
  "2xFLAG does not end with the 1xFLAG tag body" =
    endsWith(tags$`2xFLAG`, rep3),
  "3xFLAG does not end with the 2xFLAG tag body" =
    endsWith(tags$`3xFLAG`, paste0(rep2, rep3)),
  "3xFLAG tag body is not the supplied flag3x" =
    tags$`3xFLAG` == paste0("ATG", flag3x),
  "A tag does not start with ATG" =
    all(map_lgl(tags, ~ substr(.x, 1, 3) == "ATG")),
  "A tag is not in frame" = all(map_int(tags, nchar) %% 3 == 0)
)

tag_tbl <- tibble(
  tag    = names(tags),
  nt     = map_int(tags, nchar),
  codons = map_int(tags, ~ nchar(.x) %/% 3),
  peptide = map_chr(tags, ~ as.character(translate(DNAString(.x))))
)
print(tag_tbl)

stopifnot(
  "1xFLAG peptide is not MDYKDDDDK" =
    tag_tbl$peptide[tag_tbl$tag == "1xFLAG"] == "MDYKDDDDK",
  "2xFLAG peptide is not MDYKDHDIDYKDDDDK" =
    tag_tbl$peptide[tag_tbl$tag == "2xFLAG"] == "MDYKDHDIDYKDDDDK",
  "3xFLAG peptide is not M + 3xFLAG" =
    tag_tbl$peptide[tag_tbl$tag == "3xFLAG"] == paste0("M", FLAG3X_AA)
)
```

# 3. Assemble and Verify the Fusions

```{r nanoluc}
nl <- load_nanoluc_construct()
```

```{r build_fusions}
P2A_AA <- "ATNFSLLKQAGDVEENPGP"
stopifnot("The p2a part does not encode the expected 19-aa P2A peptide" =
            as.character(translate(DNAString(pseq[["p2a"]]))) == P2A_AA)

fusions <- map(tags, ~ paste0(.x, pseq[["p2a"]], nl$full))
names(fusions) <- paste0(names(tags), "-P2A-NanoLuc")

cat("Fusion ORF validation:\n")
iwalk(fusions, ~ check_orf(.x, .y))

nl_aa_full <- as.character(translate(DNAString(nl$full)))

iwalk(fusions, function(f, nm) {
  aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(f)))
  tag_nt <- tags[[sub("-P2A-NanoLuc", "", nm)]]
  stopifnot(
    "Fusion length is not the sum of its parts" =
      nchar(f) == nchar(tag_nt) + nchar(pseq[["p2a"]]) + nchar(nl$full),
    "P2A peptide not found exactly once in the fusion protein" =
      lengths(gregexpr(P2A_AA, aa, fixed = TRUE)) == 1,
    # A frame slip at either join changes every downstream residue, so this is
    # the check that catches it.
    "Fusion does not end with the full NanoLuc + PEST protein" =
      endsWith(aa, nl_aa_full),
    "NanoLuc portion of the fusion is not bit-identical to the construct" =
      substr(f, nchar(f) - nchar(nl$full) + 1, nchar(f)) == nl$full,
    "Fusion does not begin with its FLAG tag" = startsWith(f, tag_nt)
  )
})
cat("All", length(fusions), "fusions: length additive, single in-frame P2A,",
    "C-terminal NanoLuc+PEST bit-identical\n")

# The three fusions must differ by exactly one repeat each, which is the only
# thing that distinguishes them.
len <- map_int(fusions, nchar)
stopifnot(
  "1x -> 2x is not one 21 nt repeat" = len[2] - len[1] == 21,
  "2x -> 3x is not one 21 nt repeat" = len[3] - len[2] == 21
)
cat("Fusion lengths:", paste(len, collapse = " / "), "nt (21 nt apart)\n")
```

```{r fusion_table}
ref_df <- tibble(
  reporter   = names(fusions),
  cds_length = map_int(fusions, nchar),
  gc_pct     = map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc_pct),
  gc3_pct    = map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc3_pct)
)

stopifnot(
  "Reporter GC% out of range"  = all(ref_df$gc_pct  >= 0 & ref_df$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "Reporter GC3% out of range" = all(ref_df$gc3_pct >= 0 & ref_df$gc3_pct <= 100),
  "A fusion is not longer than NanoLuc alone" =
    all(ref_df$cds_length > nchar(nl$full))
)

print(ref_df %>% mutate(across(c(gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1))))

# Colours avoid the density-curve hues (grey70 / #E69F00) and the two reserved
# factor hues (#E69F00 eIF3d, #56B4E9 eIF3e).
ref_plot_df <- ref_df %>%
  mutate(color    = c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#CC79A7"),
         linetype = "solid")
```

# 4. MDA-MB-231 Background and Gene Set

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Direction check. These files hold the sictrl_vs_si3d coefficient despite the
# filename stating the ratio the other way round, so positive te_lfc = eIF3d
# promotes. EIF3D's own rna_lfc must be strongly positive because the siRNA
# depletes its target.
eif3d_rna <- te_hyp %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc is not strongly positive: contrast direction may be flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)
cat("Direction check - EIF3D rna_lfc:", round(eif3d_rna, 2), "\n")

promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, te_padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)
cat("eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes:", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

```{r transcripts}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                   "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))
tx_all      <- fm %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)
tx_promotes <- tx_all %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean)

missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean]

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"), col_types = "cc") %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
            gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

extra_tx_df <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>% dplyr::select(Name, TPM)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name)) %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids, mean_tpm > 0) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
            by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
cat("Promoted genes with a transcript:", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
```

```{r build_metrics}
metrics_all <- build_cds_metrics(
  here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))

expressed <- tx_all %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>% filter(cds_length > 0)
promoted <- tx_promotes %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>% filter(cds_length > 0)

cat("Expressed transcriptome - valid CDS:", nrow(expressed), "\n")
cat("eIF3d promoted        - valid CDS:", nrow(promoted), "\n")

stopifnot(
  "GC% out of range"  = all(expressed$gc_pct  >= 0 & expressed$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "GC3% out of range" = all(expressed$gc3_pct >= 0 & expressed$gc3_pct <= 100),
  "GC3 median not in expected range [40, 65]" =
    between(median(expressed$gc3_pct), 40, 65)
)

actb <- expressed %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% dplyr::slice(1)
if (nrow(actb) == 1) {
  stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC% outside expected 50-70%" = between(actb$gc_pct, 50, 70))
  cat("ACTB CDS GC%:", round(actb$gc_pct, 2),
      "| GC3%:", round(actb$gc3_pct, 2), "\n")
}
```

# 6. Percentiles and How Little the Tags Separate

```{r percentiles}
pct_tbl <- reporter_percentiles(expressed, promoted, ref_df)
print(pct_tbl)

stopifnot("Percentiles must lie in [0, 100]" =
            all(pct_tbl$pct_expressed >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_expressed <= 100 &
                pct_tbl$pct_promoted  >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_promoted  <= 100))

write_csv(pct_tbl,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design", "04_flag_percentiles_vs_231.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/04_flag_percentiles_vs_231.csv\n")
```

The three constructs span a small range on every axis. Quantifying that spread is
the honest version of what the overlapping reference lines show.

```{r spread}
spread <- tibble(
  metric = c("cds_length", "gc_pct", "gc3_pct"),
  min    = c(min(ref_df$cds_length), min(ref_df$gc_pct), min(ref_df$gc3_pct)),
  max    = c(max(ref_df$cds_length), max(ref_df$gc_pct), max(ref_df$gc3_pct))
) %>%
  mutate(
    construct_range = max - min,
    # How much of each gene distribution's own spread that range covers. A tiny
    # fraction means the three constructs are, for this analysis, one point.
    gene_iqr_expressed = c(IQR(expressed$cds_length), IQR(expressed$gc_pct),
                           IQR(expressed$gc3_pct)),
    pct_of_gene_iqr = round(100 * construct_range / gene_iqr_expressed, 1),
    across(c(min, max, construct_range, gene_iqr_expressed), ~ round(.x, 1))
  )
print(spread)

write_csv(spread,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design", "04_flag_construct_spread.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/04_flag_construct_spread.csv\n")
```

```{r part_contributions}
part_df <- tibble(
  part = c("1xFLAG tag (ATG+)", "2xFLAG tag (ATG+)", "3xFLAG tag (ATG+)",
           "P2A", "NanoLuc construct"),
  seq  = c(tags$`1xFLAG`, tags$`2xFLAG`, tags$`3xFLAG`,
           pseq[["p2a"]], nl$full)
) %>%
  transmute(part,
            nt      = nchar(seq),
            codons  = nchar(seq) %/% 3,
            gc_pct  = map_dbl(seq, gc_pct_of),
            gc3_pct = map_dbl(seq, compute_gc3_pct)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1)))
print(part_df)

write_csv(part_df,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design", "04_flag_part_composition.csv"))

seq_out <- tibble(
  reporter = names(fusions),
  length_nt_stop_free = map_int(fusions, nchar),
  gc_pct  = round(map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc_pct), 3),
  gc3_pct = round(map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc3_pct), 3),
  bases   = unlist(fusions, use.names = FALSE)
)
write_csv(seq_out,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               "04_flag_assembled_sequences.csv"))
cat("Exported: 04_flag_part_composition.csv, 04_flag_assembled_sequences.csv\n")
```

# 7. Summary

```{r summary}
cat("=== FLAG-P2A-NanoLuc constructs vs MDA-MB-231 ===\n\n")
cat("Assembly: ATG + <nested FLAG tag> + P2A (19 aa) + NanoLuc + junction/PEST\n")
cat("Tags cut from the C-terminal end of the supplied flag3x, so 1x is nested\n")
cat("inside 2x inside 3x, all using the spreadsheet's own codons.\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ref_df))) {
  cat(sprintf("%-24s %5d nt (%3d codons)  GC %.1f%%  GC3 %.1f%%\n",
              ref_df$reporter[i], ref_df$cds_length[i],
              ref_df$cds_length[i] / 3, ref_df$gc_pct[i], ref_df$gc3_pct[i]))
}

cat(sprintf("\nMDA-MB-231 medians: all expressed %.0f nt / GC3 %.1f%% | promoted %.0f nt / GC3 %.1f%%\n",
            median(expressed$cds_length), median(expressed$gc3_pct),
            median(promoted$cds_length),  median(promoted$gc3_pct)))

cat("\nSpread across the three constructs, as a share of the transcriptome IQR:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(spread))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-11s range %7.1f  = %.1f%% of the expressed IQR (%.1f)\n",
              spread$metric[i], spread$construct_range[i],
              spread$pct_of_gene_iqr[i], spread$gene_iqr_expressed[i]))
}

cat("\nPercentile of each construct:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pct_tbl))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-24s %-11s %7.1f  ->  %5.1f pct expressed, %5.1f pct promoted\n",
              pct_tbl$reporter[i], pct_tbl$metric[i], pct_tbl$reporter_value[i],
              pct_tbl$pct_expressed[i], pct_tbl$pct_promoted[i]))
}
```
